name: oasis-ingestion
description: Prepare, validate, review, and explicitly hand off protected evidence imports to an existing Elephant service.

interface.shortDescription: Review and import evidence into Elephant
interface.longDescription: A guarded ingestion workflow for inventorying selected evidence, resolving mappings with the data owner, generating and validating Elephant CSV manifests, configuring a private client runtime, and importing only after review and explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this data package for reviewed OASIS ingestion.
Validate this Elephant import manifest offline.
Configure and check an existing Elephant target.
